reason: Opcodes all real on the 65SC12 (DEC A = &3A, ORA #imm, STA abs; no Rockwell bits). sky_s/sky_n/sky_skip/sky_j8 are zero page (&D2/&DE/&DF/&E1); the tables at &BC90-&BCB9 indexed by small X and sky_blk_lo/hi at &A356/&A35E + small Y never cross a page. Bytes recounted: sky_row 22 -> 18 + SKIP 1 (sky_draw &30A3 -> &30A0); sky_draw prologue 10 -> 18 (.row &30AD -> &30B2); row body to the ADC 16 -> 11, so ADC sky_j8 is back at &30BD and everything after (.cell &3101, line8 &3104, next_row &3133, done &313D, sky_zero &313E, sky_img0 &317F) keeps its address: net 0 bytes, the existing cell+1/cell+2 SMC and its LO/HI(line8) unchanged; JMP row is absolute. Cycles: sky_row saves EOR 2 + SEC 2 + ADC 2 + LDA zp 3 - DEC A 2 = 5 per call (callers sky_draw, sky_zero, sky_check); each sky_draw row also saves LDY zp 3 + BEQ 3 (s=0, taken, no page cross) or 2+ORA 2 (s=1) + CLC 2 - ORA# 2 = 6/7; sky_draw pays 13 once per call (LDA zp 3, ASL 2, ASL 2, STA abs 4, CLC 2; the claim says 11, omitting the CLC), recovered after one or two rows (nq >= 3). sky_rn is 1..8 on every row (sky_geom: bottom L+1 with L 0-7; middle 8; top the remainder of H-(L+1) >= 15 after subtracting 8 while >= 9, so 1..8; split rows copy those), so (n-1) EOR 7 = 8-n exactly, and A/Z at exit equal the old LDA sky_skip's; C/V at exit differ but every caller's next carry use is preceded by ASL (bit 7 of sky_skip <= 7 is 0, as before), SEC, or CPX. Hoisted CLC: .row is entered after LDX #0/CLC or from next_row's CPX sky_nq with BEQ done not taken and X <= nq, so C = 0; nothing before the ADC touches C. sky_s is only ever 0 or 1 (TXA/SBC #10 for slots 10-11), so ORA #(4*sky_s) = the old conditional ORA #4. g93_or+1 is written at entry in the same ACCCON state as the ORA in the same call, as the existing STA cell+1; no other code writes it or reads the region as data.
